definitions: To stop an activity or a game temporarily, often for a short break or to address a situation.
To take a break from one's usual activities or responsibilities.
To suspend a player from a game for a short period as a penalty.
For a device or system to cease operation or become inactive after a period of no activity.
examples: The coach called a time out to discuss strategy.
I need to time out from work and relax for a bit.
The player was timed out for unsportsmanlike conduct.
The screen will time out after five minutes of inactivity.
